official_status: título propio — 'Máster de Formación Permanente' is the post-RD 822/2021 legal name for a título propio (the university's own certificate). NOT ANECA-verified, NOT an official máster universitario, no RUCT entry. CONFIRMED by three independent checks: (1) no RUCT code appears anywhere on the page; (2) the title is absent from output/ruct-backbone.jsonl and from the RUCT list of UNIE titles; (3) UNIE's own site classifies it under 'Máster de Formación Permanente', a category it keeps separate from its 26 'Máster Universitario' pages
meces_level: NOT IN MECES — a título propio is outside the Marco Español de Cualificaciones para la Educación Superior entirely. It has no MECES level, not a lower one
eqf_level: NOT IN EQF/EHEA — no level, because MECES is the Spanish referencing instrument into the EQF and this qualification is not in MECES
europe_recognition: NOT RECOGNISED AS A SECOND-CYCLE DEGREE ANYWHERE IN EUROPE AS OF RIGHT. This is a título propio (Máster de Formación Permanente): the university's own certificate. It is not in MECES, therefore not referenced to EQF/EHEA level 7, it is outside the Bologna framework, it carries NO Diploma Supplement as of right, and it grants NO access to doctoral study in Spain or elsewhere. It carries 60 ECTS and may be respected by employers — Ericsson is named as industrial partner — but there is NO automatic academic recognition in another European country: any recognition is entirely at the discretion of the receiving institution or employer, case by case, with no legal instrument behind it. Do not read the page's phrase 'con la oficialidad que otorga ANECA' as a claim about this title: it appears inside a generic marketing block about UNIE's anti-fraud online exam-proctoring system, several sentences away from any statement about the qualification, and ANECA has verified no such título.
